title: Quantiles for multivariate distribution: a short survey of population concepts
summary: Quantiles are among the most fundamental concepts in Probability and Statistics, from descriptive to inferential. However, quantile functions are well-defined and well-understood in the context of one-dimensional probability distributions, where their definition as the inverse of distribution functions---a definition which is intimately related to the canonical ordering of the real line.
